The configured accountId is read from the extension's persisted USER_PROFILE only after the live account UI shows admin@admin.com/admin; product applyCanonicalSession restores the bearer, cryptographically verifies its current subject, and rejects a profile whose id differs from that verified subject. The actual product query is adminDb().from('admins').select('user_id').eq('user_id', userId).limit(1) in src/lib/supabase/queries.ts.
